title: Chapter 85
content_en: MGA: Chapter 85 – Danger Lurks Everywhere“I never would have thought that there was going to be a good show already. It’s already hard to say whether Chu Feng can even live past a year.”“Yeah, how can he even survive in the core zone after offending senior Gong? Even if senior Gong doesn’t attack, many people would be troubling him. With his current strength, it’s really quite hard to continue in this place.”As they looked at the scene in front of them, the surrounding crowd coldly smiled. They felt that Chu Feng was going to be crazily beaten up today. After all, Chu Feng’s strength was only at the 7th level of the Spirit realm. In addition to his horrible talent, in the core zone, take any single person and they could beat him up to the point...
